verdict.rationale: Firstbase has a registered-agent service you can start online: you fill out company details and it will legally change your registered agent in your incorporation state (firstbase-docs-2), and the service page includes a compliance dashboard (firstbase-docs-6). Nothing in the evidence shows a founder receives the exact agent name and street address to put on their own formation or change filing, let alone the same day. The physical business address in the pricing tier is a mail address, not the registered-agent address. Missing for 10: disclosure of the agent's name and street address for the founder's own filing, a same-day or instant turnaround, coverage across states for the agent service, and independent corroboration.
